name: Compressed Segmentation Volume
aliases: Iterative Refinement Compression for Segmentation Volumes
definition: A compression technique for segmentation volumes (uint32_t labels) that uses a multi-grid hierarchy and run-length-like encoding with rANS secondary compression to store label data efficiently.
summary: Compressed Segmentation Volume is a lossless compression technique for voxel-based segmentation data that achieves extreme size reduction by encoding label regions and boundaries via iterative refinement and entropy coding.
